_about: Game knowledge, shared by every run: creature kinds (verdicts, what they did to us) and foods safe to eat on our own. World knowledge (places, people, sightings, notes, loot, quests) stays per run in runs/<id>/world.json. brain/world.py reads this file on load and writes it back on save; run files don't store kinds or food. Started from run 7b7d009c (Ushrorooshum), 2026-11-24. Verdicts (verdict, shoot, harmless, difficulty) are judgments for one build, level and gear; observations (max_hit, xp, effects, mobile, ranged...) hold for any character. A different build re-judges verdicts.

dreadroot.xp_note: died to 2 damage, gave no XP

irritable tortoise.note: carapace tightens: musket slugs fail 4x in a row, axe rarely penetrates; ray only or leave

guard dog.note: one bite did 8 (killed us at 5 HP); Ithri-Sehian family guard at Maggatum

effects: The hulking baboon hits with a small boulder (x5) for 9 damage
explodes when killed: 8 and 14 damage at level 1 (two pods chained), turn 159967

messages.You pour fresh water from your waterskin: Amphibious, the defect every character of our setup (Mutated Human Marauder) has: when we dry out, the game pours fresh water from a skin over us. Happens on every world-map step and sometimes in town; the water status reads 'Wet'. Water is a core resource: about 4 drams per 1000 turns plus one per world-map step (research/character.md, research/design.md). Not a danger, not a mystery.

_about_messages: Game messages we have explained, keyed by their text: look here (tools/known.py) before calling a message new or unexplained.
